title: thlaspi rotundifolium var. cenisium
intro: Thlaspi rotundifolium var. cenisium, commonly known as alpine penny cress, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of T. rotundifolium var. cenisium include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders, as well as its potential to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its potential therapeutic effects, as well as other compounds such as phenolic acids and flavonoids.
